text: Carpentry relies heavily on sanding and sawing. Sanding comes first; it levels rough edges and eliminates splinters. Operators achieve this with either manual sandpaper or an electric sander. After smoothing the surface, the wood requires cutting to specific dimensions or forms. This phase employs various tools such as general woodworking blades, power units, or circular models. These two operations enable carpenters to construct durable and attractive wooden items.
